    Forecast GDP Growth using ARIMA with Pandemic Intervention Dummies

    forecast_gdp.Rd

    Fits an automated ARIMA model on quarter-on-quarter log GDP growth rates and projects multi-step log GDP levels forward. Automatically detects and includes pulse intervention regressors for 2020 Q2 and 2020 Q3 when active in the historical sample window.

    forecast_gdp(data, date_col, gdp_col, horizon = 8, hp_lambda = 1600)

    Arguments

    data

    A data frame containing historical quarterly dates and log GDP series.

    date_col

    Character. Column name identifying quarterly dates in data.

    gdp_col

    Character. Column name containing log GDP values.

    horizon

    Integer. Out-of-sample forecast horizon in quarters. Defaults to 8.

    hp_lambda

    Numeric. Smoothing parameter for downstream HP filter routines (retained for interface compatibility). Defaults to 1600.

    Value

    A tibble containing:

    quarter

    Quarterly dates of class yearqtr spanning historical and forecast periods.

    log_gdp

    Combined historical and projected log GDP levels.

    type

    Character indicator distinguishing "History" from "Forecast".

    Details

    The model computes first differences of log GDP (\(\Delta y_t = y_t - y_{t-1}\)) and estimates an optimal ARIMA(\(p,d,q\)) specification via forecast::auto.arima. Out-of-sample growth forecasts (\(\Delta \hat{y}_{T+h|T}\)) are cumulated onto the terminal historical level: $$\hat{y}_{T+h|T} = y_T + \sum_{j=1}^h \Delta \hat{y}_{T+j|T}$$

    Exogenous pulse dummies (dummy_2020q2, dummy_2020q3) are integrated dynamically via xreg and set to zero across the forecast horizon, with edge-case checks to prevent collinearity on rolling sample boundaries.
